name: @modelcontextprotocol/server-slack
description: Official Model Context Protocol server for Slack workspace integration. Allows AI assistants to inspect channels, post messages, add reactions, and fetch thread context.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public or private channels in the connected Slack workspace.

types.description: Comma-separated list of channel types (public_channel, private_channel)

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a specified Slack channel.

channel_id.description: The ID of the channel to post to

thread_ts.description: Optional parent message timestamp to post in a thread

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.description: Fetch historical messages from a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message.
